description: Generates a DESIGN.md file for any website URL or fetches a pre-built one from the awesome-design-md collection (55+ sites). DESIGN.md captures the complete design system of a real product — exact hex/oklch values, font families, spacing scales, shadow formulas, component states, do's and don'ts — in a format vibe-design reads to produce pixel-accurate matching UI. Three modes: (A) fetch a pre-built DESIGN.md from the catalog by site name (instant, exact tokens); (B) generate one from any URL by reading the site's rendered CSS and visual language (~2 min); (C) INGEST a design the user already made — a mockup/screenshot image (PNG/JPG), a prototype HTML/CSS file, or a written description — and extract it into DESIGN.md, so a look designed elsewhere (e.g. in the Claude desktop app) satisfies the pipeline's design gate without redoing it. Output always saved to project root as DESIGN.md. Triggers on "design-md:", "generate a design system for", "extract design tokens from", "make it look like [brand]", "get the design system for", "fetch DESIGN.md for", "create DESIGN.md from", "ingest this mockup/design", "turn this prototype/screenshot into DESIGN.md", "here's the design I made". After output: vibe-design reads DESIGN.md automatically in Step 2.
